rows.name: MVRV Z-Score
rows.blurb: Market cap vs realized cap in standard deviations. Deep lows marked historic bottoms; extremes above ~7 marked every major top.

rows.name: MVRV Ratio
rows.blurb: Market value / realized value. Below ~1 the average holder is underwater; above ~3.5 is historically overheated.

rows.name: Net Unrealized P/L (NUPL)
rows.blurb: Share of supply sitting in profit. Negative = capitulation; above ~0.75 = the euphoria zone of past tops.

rows.name: SOPR
rows.blurb: Spent-output profit ratio. Sustained sub-1 = coins selling at a loss; persistently rich = heavy profit-taking near tops.

rows.name: Reserve Risk
rows.blurb: Long-term-holder conviction vs price. Lows flag attractive risk/reward; highs flag late-cycle complacency.

rows.name: Short-Term Holder MVRV
rows.blurb: Cost-basis ratio of recent buyers. Deep lows = fresh money underwater; extremes = new buyers sitting on top-heavy gains.

rows.name: Long-Term Holder MVRV
rows.blurb: Cost-basis ratio of seasoned holders. Lows accompany bear-market bottoms; extremes accompany distribution tops.

rows.name: Puell Multiple
rows.blurb: Daily miner issuance in USD vs its yearly average. Sub-0.5 marked every cycle low; above ~4 marked blow-off tops.

rows.name: RHODL Ratio
rows.blurb: Realized-cap HODL waves (1-week vs 1–2-year bands). Lows = speculation flushed out; highs = froth at cycle peaks.

rows.name: Hash Ribbons
rows.blurb: 30-day vs 60-day hashrate momentum. Dips below 1 mark miner-capitulation bottoms; says nothing about tops.

rows.name: Realized Price
rows.blurb: Aggregate on-chain cost basis. Spot below it = the market underwater; spot far above it = historically stretched.

rows.name: Balanced Price
rows.blurb: Realized minus transferred price. Spot near it marked cycle bottoms; a large premium marked late-cycle heat.

rows.name: Mayer Multiple
rows.blurb: Price vs its 200-day average. Readings near 0.5 marked deep bottoms; above ~2.4 marked overheated tops.

rows.name: 200-Week MA Ratio
rows.blurb: Price vs its 200-week average — the line macro bottoms touch; multiples of ~3+ accompanied past tops.

rows.name: Pi Cycle Bottom
rows.blurb: 150-day EMA vs 0.745× the 471-day average. Ratios near/below 1 have pinned cycle lows; says nothing about tops.

rows.name: Pi Cycle Top
rows.blurb: 111-day MA vs 2× the 350-day MA. The upward cross of 1 called the 2013, 2017 and 2021 tops within days.
